title: Hearty American Roast Vegetable Soup
description: A comforting, flavorful soup made with roasted vegetables and hearty american ingredients.

ingredients.name: Roast
ingredients.notes: such as butternut squash or carrots

instructions: Peel and chop the Roast into 1-inch pieces.
Toss the Roast with 1 tablespoon of Olive oil, Salt, and Black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of Olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped Shungiku and cook until wilted.
Add the crushed Tomatoes, Hearty, and roasted Roast to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
